name: sma12_monthly_momentum
economic_rationale: Time-series (absolute) momentum risk premium — persistent trend autocorrelation documented across assets (Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen); the filter truncates left-tail drawdowns by exiting sustained downtrends. Strongest, most-replicated edge in the batch.
entry_logic: Long the index when monthly close > 12mo SMA; flat to cash below. SMA beats EMA for this filter.
parameters_sketch: entry monthly close > 12mo SMA; exit close < SMA; execute at close or next open; ~70% time in market. Test on continuous ES/MES back-adjusted series.
dedupe_note: Distinct from supertrend_weekly (monthly TS-momentum vs weekly volatility-trailing-stop).

implementation_status.gate_v2_verdict: FAIL_dd_threshold_mismatch (3/4 CORE pass; mc_dd 21.9% vs 6% intraday cap)

name: spy_overnight_hold
economic_rationale: Well-documented close-to-open drift / overnight risk-premium anomaly — the bulk of SPY's historical return accrues overnight while intraday is ~flat (overnight risk-bearing compensation + index-futures fair-value carry). Trivially testable, no options/microstructure data needed.
entry_logic: Buy MOC, sell MOO next session; flat intraday. Capture the overnight drift.
parameters_sketch: entry buy MOC, exit sell MOO; optional VIX-regime / prior-day-return filter; benchmark vs buy&hold; test SPY cash vs overnight ES session for futures translation.

implementation_status.gate_v2_verdict: FAIL_dd_threshold_mismatch (3/4 CORE pass; gross of close/open spread)

name: dealer_gamma_regime
economic_rationale: Options-dealer delta-hedging microstructure: short-gamma dealers hedge pro-cyclically (buy strength/sell weakness) amplifying moves; long-gamma dealers hedge counter-cyclically, dampening vol and pinning to large-gamma strikes. Mechanical, non-news flow — genuinely documented.
entry_logic: Sign of net dealer gamma sets the day's regime: negative GEX / spot below gamma-flip -> vol expansion, trade momentum/breakout; positive GEX / spot above flip -> vol suppression + pinning, fade extremes toward gamma-neutral/wall level. Exit EOD.
parameters_sketch: Compute daily net GEX + zero-gamma flip from options OI (SpotGamma/MenthorQ/Unusual Whales or own chain); GEX<0 or spot<flip -> take opening-range breakout; else fade to prior VWAP/nearest wall; exit EOD. Needs a GEX data-feed decision before it can run on the ES engine.
dedupe_note: MERGED 6 near-identical GEX/gamma hypotheses (gex_dealer_gamma_regime, gex_negative_gamma_momentum, gex_flip_spy, dealer_gamma_regime, spx_gamma_pin, qqq_gamma_flip_regime) into one canonical dealer-gamma-regime edge; all describe the same mean-revert-if-long-gamma / momentum-if-short-gamma mechanism across SPX/SPY/QQQ/ES.

name: supertrend_weekly_spx
economic_rationale: Multi-week trend-following momentum persistence in equity indices; a volatility-scaled trailing stop cuts time-at-risk and drawdown vs buy-and-hold. Same premium family as sma12 but different horizon/exit mechanic.
entry_logic: Long S&P on weekly Supertrend (ATR10, mult3) buy signal; flat to cash on sell. Long-only.
parameters_sketch: Supertrend ATR=10, mult=3, weekly bars, long-only, flat below band. Compare to sma12 and buy&hold; watch for over-tuned multiplier (grid 2-4).
dedupe_note: Kept separate from sma12 (weekly vol-stop trend vs monthly SMA cross); overlaps in spirit — backtest jointly to avoid double-counting the trend premium.

name: atr_band_breakout
economic_rationale: Volatility expansion after contraction tends to trend; ATR-scaling adapts entry distance to current vol so signals fire on regime shifts not noise. Directly on ES, no exotic data.
entry_logic: Bands at MA +/- k*ATR; long on close above upper, short below lower; exit on return to MA. Test breakout vs mean-reversion polarity.
parameters_sketch: MA=20, ATR=14, k=2-3; entry close beyond band; exit cross to MA or opposite band. Must test both polarities — the direction of edge is the open question.

name: kaufman_efficiency_adaptive_trend
economic_rationale: ER measures signal-to-noise of price travel; trend edge concentrates in high-efficiency regimes and bleeds out in chop — regime-conditioning is a real filter. Portable Pine logic already exists (Adaptive Volatility Trend indicator).
entry_logic: Kaufman Efficiency Ratio drives an adaptive MA + ATR bands: trade with trend when ER high (bands tighten), stand aside in low-ER chop.
parameters_sketch: ER len=10; adaptive MA 2/30; long when price>AMA & ER>0.5 & signal-score>60; ATR-band exit. Port the free non-repainting Pine indicator's logic to the ES engine.

name: rth_open_liquidity_sweep_reversion
economic_rationale: Stop-loss and breakout orders cluster at obvious prior highs/lows; price is drawn to trigger them (liquidity grab), then reverts once fuel is exhausted. Classic stop-hunt microstructure/behavioral edge; med confidence and concrete levels.
entry_logic: Map prior-day / overnight high & low; when price sweeps a level in first 60-90m of RTH and fails to hold, fade back toward the opposite pool / session VWAP.
parameters_sketch: Levels = prior RTH high/low + overnight high/low; entry = sweep + rejection candle within first 90m; stop beyond sweep extreme; target opposite liquidity or VWAP. Cleanly testable on ES intraday bars.

name: delta_hedged_short_straddle_vrp
economic_rationale: Variance risk premium — implied persistently exceeds realized because investors overpay for crash/vol insurance; delta-hedging strips direction to isolate the premium. Among the strongest rationales in the batch, but it is a short-vol/tail-risk collector (needs strict sizing + tail hedge).
entry_logic: Sell 7-DTE ATM straddle each Friday, delta-hedge every 24h, hold to expiry at constant notional; harvest IV-minus-RV.
parameters_sketch: Fri 08:00 sell ATM 7DTE straddle; re-hedge to flat every 24h; $100k constant notional; exit at expiry. Requires SPX options chain + delta-hedge sim — NOT native to the ES futures backtest engine; instrument/infra decision needed. Gate hard on MC tail-drawdown given short-gamma profile.

name: vol_target_deleveraging_downside
economic_rationale: Risk-parity / vol-targeting funds cut equity exposure when realized vol jumps; forced, price-insensitive, clustered selling creates positive-feedback downside ('elevator down') asymmetric to the slower grind up. Plausible, testable on ES daily.
entry_logic: After a sharp down day with a realized-vol spike, expect continued/accelerating downside over 1-3 days as vol-targeting funds mechanically deleverage.
parameters_sketch: trigger 1d return < -1.5% AND realized-vol jump > Xth pctile; short ES; exit after 3 days or vol mean-reversion. Explicitly test up/down asymmetry so it isn't just short-bias in a bull sample.

name: stat_arb_pairs
economic_rationale: Two economically-linked assets share a common stochastic trend; transient divergence is corrected by relative-value flows — market-neutral mean-reversion, not directional. Classic, well-posed, but equities not ES.
entry_logic: Trade a cointegrated pair's spread z-score: short rich / long cheap leg at |z| threshold, exit on reversion.
parameters_sketch: Engle-Granger/Johansen cointegration; entry |z|>2, exit |z|<0.5, stop |z|>3.5, rolling 60d hedge ratio. Needs an equities data pipeline; out-of-scope for a pure futures engine unless a futures-spread analogue is chosen (e.g. calendar/inter-market).
dedupe_note: Kept separate from pca_residual_stat_arb (single explicit pair vs PCA-factor residual on a basket).

name: pca_residual_stat_arb
economic_rationale: Avellaneda-Lee statistical arbitrage — residual after removing systematic factor exposure is Ornstein-Uhlenbeck mean-reverting. Real and cited, but heaviest infra of the batch (universe, rolling PCA, dollar-neutral book) and not futures.
entry_logic: PCA-decompose a universe into ~5 factors, trade the mean-reverting idiosyncratic residual per name (s-score).
parameters_sketch: rolling 60d PCA; regress each name on top 5 PCs; s-score = residual/rolling-std; enter |s|>1.25, exit |s|<0.5, dollar-neutral. Low priority for a futures desk; capacity/infra dependent.

name: ib_orb_session_structure
economic_rationale: Opening-auction order flow: early directional imbalance persists as latecomers chase (continuation), while wide early ranges signal exhausted flow (reversion). Plausible microstructure but low individual confidence and heavy multiple-testing risk across the sub-rules.
entry_logic: Family of opening-auction structure rules: (a) the IB extreme that forms FIRST tends to break first — trade continuation of that side; (b) ORB close sign predicts IB finish direction (bias filter); (c) condition the break on IB width — narrow IB -> breakout, wide IB -> fade to IB mid.
parameters_sketch: IB=09:30-10:30 ET; features = first-formed extreme, ORB(5-15m) close sign, IB-width percentile vs trailing 20d; entry stop-breakout or fade per rule; exit EOD or 1R. Encoded in the two open-source Pine mappers — port stats to engine; treat as ONE study with a global trial counter, not three edges.
dedupe_note: MERGED 3 hypotheses (ib_orb_first_form_break_continuation, orb_close_predicts_ib_direction, ib_range_width_conditioned_break) — same session-structure family from the same two TradingView scripts.

name: rv_iv_meanrev
economic_rationale: Short-horizon overreaction + VRP: a realized move outpacing priced IV signals liquidity-driven overshoot that market-makers lean against. Reasonable but needs per-name IV data and is long-biased (bull-sample risk).
entry_logic: When a name's realized move is large relative to its implied move, buy the mean reversion with a limit.
parameters_sketch: trigger |ret_1-5d| > k*IV_daily; limit-buy the extension; exit on revert. Needs options IV feed; not futures-native.
dedupe_note: Kept separate from delta_hedged_short_straddle_vrp (directional reversion signal vs delta-hedged premium harvest).

name: ict_smc_zone_reversion
economic_rationale: FVGs/order-blocks proxy thin-liquidity / absorbed-institutional-size zones where inventory rebalancing pulls price back. Weakest rationale tier — detection is fuzzy/discretionary and heavily curve-fit-prone; only proceed with strict OOS + permutation tests.
entry_logic: Fade into ICT/SMC zones: (a) return to an unfilled Fair Value Gap -> fade toward gap midpoint; (b) retest of the last opposing 'order block' before an impulse -> enter with the block.
parameters_sketch: Use smart-money-concepts lib for FVG/OB detection; entry on retest, stop beyond zone origin, target midpoint/prior swing; trend filter. Objectify the detection rules before any claim of edge.
dedupe_note: MERGED fvg_fill_reversion + order_block_bounce (same tom_doerr source, same smart-money-concepts library, same zone-reversion mechanism).

name: ema_9_20_pullback_15m
economic_rationale: Short-horizon trend/momentum persistence via order-flow autocorrelation; pullback entry improves R:R. Generic and over-common; likely thin edge after costs.
entry_logic: On 15m, long when 9EMA>20EMA and price pulls back into the band then resumes; mirror short; exit next swing pivot.
parameters_sketch: fast 9EMA / slow 20EMA; entry retrace into band in trend direction; stop beyond band; TP prior swing; ATR chop filter. Cheap to test on ES 15m.

name: 9ema_reclaim_continuation
economic_rationale: 9EMA is a widely-watched reference; clustered stops + momentum-chaser orders above it create a self-fulfilling near-term continuation. Behavioral/order-flow but very thin and crowded.
entry_logic: After price reclaims the 9EMA following a down-move and the pullback holds it as support, go long for the continuation leg.
parameters_sketch: entry: close reclaims 9EMA + successful retest; stop below retest low; exit 1.5-3R or first close below 9EMA. Objectify 'retest holds' before testing.
dedupe_note: MERGED 9ema_flip_rally + 9ema_flip_rally_v2 (identical reclaim-then-hold-9EMA continuation setup, same author).

name: pca_regime_factor_overlays
economic_rationale: High PC1 (correlation) share collapses idiosyncratic edge -> systematic risk-on/off regime; rising PC3 loading means equity moves are rate-driven -> hedge unintended factor exposure. Genuine factor-timing logic but overlay/sizing, not a standalone signal — hard to validate PnL attribution.
entry_logic: Use rolling PCA on constituents as a risk overlay: (a) when PC1 variance share is high, cut single-name/dispersion bets and lean directional; (b) when PC3 (rate-sensitivity) variance share spikes, hedge equity book's implied rate exposure with duration instruments.
parameters_sketch: rolling 60d PCA on S&P constituents; PC1 var-share pctile gates directional vs rotation book; PC3 z>2 overlays ZN/ZB hedge sized to PC3 loading. Speculative; requires full equity + rate data stack.
dedupe_note: MERGED pca_regime_position_sizing + pc3_rate_beta_hedge (both rolling-PCA factor overlays from the same source; complementary, not standalone edges).

name: wyckoff_accumulation_breakout
economic_rationale: Wyckoff accumulation = institutions absorbing supply; the spring flushes weak longs before markup. Behavioral/microstructure narrative but the pattern is discretionary and hard to specify — high subjectivity, low confidence.
entry_logic: After a multi-week range with declining vol and a spring/shakeout low, long the breakout above range highs; target 1x range height.
parameters_sketch: range detect via ATR contraction over 15-30 bars; spring = false break below range low then reclaim; entry close above range high; stop below spring low; target 1x range height. Must fully objectify range/spring detection to be testable.

name: rl_execution_cost_minimization
economic_rationale: Execution edge, not alpha — optimal slicing against transient order-book impact preserves signal PnL (Almgren-Chriss / RL execution literature). Legitimate but it improves other strategies rather than generating standalone returns; low priority until an alpha is capacity-constrained by costs.
entry_logic: RL/DQN execution agent schedules child orders to keep realized slippage below the alpha being captured.
parameters_sketch: state = LOB imbalance+spread+remaining qty+time; action = child size/aggression; reward = -(slippage vs arrival); benchmark vs TWAP/VWAP. Needs L2 order-book sim (HftBacktest). Deprioritize until a live strategy is cost-bound.
